query:
SELECT state_code, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, rating, status
FROM senate_races 
WHERE status = 'General' AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY state_code
LIMIT 20;
